name: Markiplier Dating Simulator
source:
Markiplier dating Simulator is a dating simulator where you can date Markiplier! There are many endings in this game and every decision you make will drastically impact your experience.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
《Markiplier恋爱模拟器》是一款可以与Markiplier约会的恋爱模拟游戏！游戏有多个结局，你作出的每个决定都会极大影响体验。

（来源：itch.io）
